facts.text: make_env is a Gymnasium environment class: the module imports gymnasium as gym and gymnasium's spaces, and the class subclasses gym.Env
Users create the environment with make_env(env_params), where env_params is a dictionary
env_params['model'] selects the process model by name, and the mapping binds 'cstr' to the cstr class
The cstr model's states are Ca and T and its single input is Tc
The CSTR balances are dcadt = q/V * (Caf - ca) - k0 * exp(-EA/R/T) * ca and dTdt = q/V * (Ti - T) - deltaHr * rA / (rho * C) + UA * (Tc - T) / (rho * C * V)
The cstr default parameters are q=100, V=100, rho=1000, C=0.239, deltaHr=-5e4, EA_over_R=8750, k0=7.2e10, UA=5e4, Ti=350 and Caf=1
normalise_a and normalise_o default to True
With normalisation the action space is Box(low=-1, high=1) with a dimension per a_space input (one for the CSTR)
With normalisation the observation space is Box(low=-1, high=1) with a dimension per o_space bound (three in the README configuration)
The simulation timestep is dt = tsim / N

The README quick-start configuration sets nsteps=100 time steps over T=25 simulation seconds, a jacket-temperature action range of 295 to 302, observation bounds [0.7, 300, 0.8] to [1, 350, 0.9], initial state [0.8, 330, 0.8] and model 'cstr'
The README quick-start setpoint is 0.85 for the first 50 steps and 0.9 for the last 50
step denormalises the action to the a_space range as (action + 1) * (high - low) / 2 + low
step advances the model's ODE with the integration engine: casadi_step when integration_method is casadi and jax_step when it is jax
step writes the setpoint value for each SP key at index t into the state after each transition
step sets done when t reaches N-1
step returns (observation, reward, done, False, info)
With SP set and no custom reward the reward is -sum over the SP states of (state - setpoint)^2 scaled by r_scale
The CSTR documentation gives the observation space bounds as [[0.7,1],[300,350],[0.8,0.9]]
The CSTR documentation describes the action as a ContinuousBox of [290,302], the jacket temperature in kelvin

determinism.notes: the served CSTR configuration is deterministic: reset restores the fixed x0 of the quick start and every trajectory follows the same ODE balances, so the same actions give the same state hashes; reset accepts a seed and the bridge echoes it, but the configured CSTR has no random initial state, noise or uncertainty, so the seed does not change the trajectory

gaps: a lumped continuous-stirred-tank model (two ODE balances for Ca and T) with an idealised cooling jacket; no contacts, no actuator dynamics, no sensor model and no noise model, and the reaction parameters are the class defaults of model_classes.py:25-34

the served configuration is only the README quick start: N=100 steps over tsim=25 s gives the 0.25 s timestep, the 295-302 K jacket range is denormalised from the action space and the observation bounds are the README o_space; another model, plant or step count is a different configuration

the fake backend integrates one explicit RK4 step with 0.01 s substeps per environment step; upstream uses casadi (or jax) through its integration engine, so trajectories and the reward stream differ from a real pc-gym run, and pc-gym was not importable where the gate ran
the fake returns Python floats and lists; upstream returns numpy arrays
snapshot and restore are not offered: make_env exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
